CREATE SCHEMA other
CREATE TYPE other.feeling AS ENUM ('sad', 'ok', 'happy')
CREATE DOMAIN other.posint2 AS integer CHECK (VALUE > 0)
CREATE DOMAIN good_mood AS other.feeling CHECK (VALUE <> 'sad')

CREATE TABLE lt (id integer PRIMARY KEY, m other.feeling DEFAULT 'ok', ms other.feeling[], p other.posint2, g good_mood, gs good_mood[], c other.feeling CONSTRAINT lt_c_check CHECK (c <> 'happy'), gen integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN m = 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) STORED)
CREATE INDEX lt_partial_idx ON lt (id) WHERE m <> 'sad'
CREATE INDEX lt_cast_idx ON lt ((p::integer))
CREATE VIEW lv AS SELECT id, m, m = 'ok' AS is_ok, 'happy'::other.feeling AS top, p::integer AS p_int, NULL::other.posint2 AS np FROM lt WHERE m <> 'sad'
CREATE FUNCTION lt_next(x other.feeling) RETURNS other.feeling LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT enum_larger(x, 'ok') $$
CREATE FUNCTION lt_double(x other.posint2) RETURNS other.posint2 LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$ SELECT (x * 2)::other.posint2 $$
CREATE FUNCTION lt_atomic(x other.feeling) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql RETURN x = 'ok'::other.feeling
CREATE FUNCTION lt_count() RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC SELECT count(*) FROM lt WHERE p > 0; END
CREATE SEQUENCE lt_seq OWNED BY lt.id
CREATE TABLE lt_child (extra integer) INHERITS (lt)
ALTER TYPE other.feeling OWNER TO dep_owner
ALTER DOMAIN other.posint2 OWNER TO dep_owner

GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA other TO dep_user

cases.sql: CREATE TYPE mood AS ENUM ('sad', 'ok')
CREATE DOMAIN pos AS integer DEFAULT 1 CHECK (VALUE > 0)
CREATE SEQUENCE ids
CREATE FUNCTION twice(x integer DEFAULT 2) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE RETURN x * 2
CREATE TABLE parent (id integer DEFAULT nextval('ids') PRIMARY KEY, label text UNIQUE, score integer DEFAULT twice(1), feeling mood)
CREATE TABLE child (id integer PRIMARY KEY, parent_id integer REFERENCES parent (id), amount pos)
CREATE TABLE measure (at date NOT NULL, value integer) PARTITION BY RANGE (at)
CREATE TABLE measure_2026 PARTITION OF measure FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-01-01') TO ('2027-01-01')
CREATE INDEX measure_at_idx ON measure (at)
CREATE FUNCTION audit() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER parent_audit BEFORE INSERT ON parent FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.feeling <> 'sad') EXECUTE FUNCTION audit()
CREATE RULE parent_notify AS ON UPDATE TO parent DO ALSO NOTIFY parent_changed
CREATE TABLE audit_log (at date, note text)
CREATE RULE parent_log AS ON INSERT TO parent DO ALSO INSERT INTO audit_log (note) VALUES (new.label)
CREATE VIEW doubled AS SELECT id, twice(score) AS twice_score FROM parent
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW moods AS SELECT feeling FROM parent
CREATE TABLE typed_default (m mood DEFAULT 'ok', p pos)
